scorecard.name: Paraphrasing
scorecard.coaching: You did not paraphrase or restate the customer's equipment fee dispute in your own words at any point in the call.

grader.scenario: Billing dispute regarding £65 non-return equipment charge for returned router
grader.notes: Nathan provides exemplary empathetic customer service and complete ownership. He validates Leila's anger warmly across multiple outbursts, tracks down the un-scanned equipment barcode in the Rugby warehouse records, reverses the £65 fee, triggers an automated BACS refund, and confirms the amended statement showing zero balance and pending refund. However, he misses Paraphrasing by never restating the issue in his own words.

items.name: Empathy & Acknowledgment Statement
items.evidence: [00:20] Agent warmly validated: 'I'm sorry to hear you've been charged for non-return of equipment when you've already posted the router back, Leila. Let me look into that warehouse return record and sort out that refund for you right away.'

items.name: Paraphrasing
items.evidence: Agent never restated the core issue in his own words; only confirmed email at turn 51.

items.name: Took ownership of the problem
items.evidence: [03:40] Agent stated: 'I will take direct ownership of this right now. I have supervisor billing override authority, and I am applying an immediate sixty-five-pound credit waiver to your closed account profile.'

items.name: Build rapport and observed professionalism
items.evidence: [02:40] Agent maintained a polite, respectful, and highly professional demeanor throughout, acknowledging warehouse errors with complete honesty.

items.name: Confirmed the issue is resolved
items.evidence: [08:15] Customer confirmed: ''Amended Final Statement - Account Balance: £0.00. Refund Dispatched: £65.00'.' with equipment return status marked as Verified Delivered.
